answer_1.quote: ClinRaGen, a multimodal framework that transfers LLM reasoning capabilities into SLMs for disease diagnosis and clinical rationale generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated clinical rationales for disease diagnosis, including medical note-based rationales and lab test-based rationales.

answer_2.quote: The performance of comparative methods... using micro and macro precision, recall, and F1 scores... BLEU and BERTScore on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets.

answer_3.quote: For LLM comparisons, we use Mistral-7B, LLaMA2-7B, and LLaMA3-8B with five-shot prompting... we use GPT-4 to evaluate 1000 randomly selected samples.

answer_4.quote: For human assessment, 15 professional postgraduates rate 100 samples...
answer_4.guideline: Using five evaluation criteria: Correctness, Readability, Soundness, Consistency, and Persuasiveness
